content.event: explicit named Work Unit execution request after admission
content.expectedResult: Controller starts one persisted codex exec session and records its UUID before continuation monitoring.

rules: Do not create a replacement session for the same active attempt.

content.concurrency: One active controller and one codexSessionId per Work Unit revision and attempt.
steps: start codex exec and capture session UUID
resume same session after nonterminal exec exit
stop only at review-ready or terminal failure

items: No claim of unattended restart when no Codex process exists.
